newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to auction C$1.5 billion bonds due 2027.
newsitem.headline: Canada to auction C$1.5 billion bonds due 2027.

text.p: The Government of Canada said it plans to auction on October 23, C$1.5 billion of bonds with a coupon of 8.00 percent and maturing on June 1, 2027.
The Bank of Canada will acquire a minimum of C$150 million of the new bonds, which will be dated and delivered on November 1.
The government said proceeds of the issue will be used for general purposes, and that there are no Government of Canada marketable bonds maturing on November 1.
The new bonds are in addition to C$3.0 billion of 8.0 percent bonds due June 1, 2027 already outstanding.
